method: Targeted content review of 4.3.1.7/8/9 and 4.6.3.4 using cached AQA 8464 and Q–V standard: teaching/revision, direct practice/application, answers/feedback, skills and shared tier eligibility. No full discovery audit or keyword-based promotion.

units.title: Vaccination
units.teachingRevision: Extended vaccination explanation: small dead/inactive pathogen quantities/antigens stimulate white cells and specific antibodies; rapid later response despite declining antibody levels; prevention versus treatment; large-population coverage and global benefits/access/cost/uptake limits.
units.assessment: q01 unfamiliar antibody-response pattern and misconceptions; q02 uneven global coverage/evaluation. Original specific-response recall and bio2-vaccine retained.
units.answersFeedback: Every new record has model answer, criteria and misconception feedback. Writing uses existing self-assessment; new resistant-percentage question accepts valid percent forms and rejects counts/physical units.
units.skillsAndPractical: WS1.4 global vaccination evaluation with individual/population mechanisms; no detailed schedules or unsupported guarantee.
units.tier: Shared Foundation/Higher requirements; effective Foundation/unsure/Higher verified; original Higher content retained.

units.title: Resistant bacteria
units.teachingRevision: Mutation/variation before exposure → antibiotic selection pressure → susceptible death/resistant survival → reproduction/inheritance → increasing resistant proportion/spread. MRSA, treatment consequences, appropriate use/adherence, agricultural restrictions, infection control, slow/costly antibiotic development. Existing Inheritance selection explanation reused unchanged.
units.assessment: q07 unfamiliar population causal sequence; q08 resistant percentage with limits; q09 integrated control/new-drug evaluation. Original bio2-resistance retained.
units.answersFeedback: Every new record has model answer, criteria and misconception feedback. Writing uses existing self-assessment; new resistant-percentage question accepts valid percent forms and rejects counts/physical units.
units.skillsAndPractical: Direct resistance/natural-selection evidence, valid percent-only answer handling, no need-driven mutation or guarantee of killing all bacteria. Prescribed-course language supported by cached specification, qualified to follow the plan and updated clinician instructions.
